title: Marketplace Orders Delivery Option Service Standards
content:
Every Marketplace Orders order is placed on one of six delivery options. The option fixes who fulfils the order, how many business days the order may spend in handling and in carrier transit, whether the promised delivery date is guaranteed, and how a seller cancellation is treated. The figures below apply to every order placed on that option.

## Service standards by delivery option

| Delivery option | Fulfilled by | Maximum handling (business days) | Maximum transit (business days) | Delivery date guaranteed | Late-delivery shipping refund request window (calendar days after delivery) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Seller Fulfilled Standard Shipping | the seller | 2 | 5 | No | not applicable |
| Seller Fulfilled Expedited Shipping | the seller | 1 | 2 | Yes | 30 |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Standard | Northloop | 1 | 4 | No | not applicable |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day | Northloop | 0 | 2 | Yes | 30 |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day | Northloop | 0 | 0 | Yes | 30 |
| Large Item Freight Delivery | the seller | 3 | 7 | Yes | 30 |

A handling figure of 0 means the order ships on the same business day it is placed; a transit figure of 0 means it is delivered on the day it ships.

## Calendar, cut-off and appointment settings

| Delivery option | Business-day calendar | Same-Day order cut-off (local time) | Freight appointment window (hours) | Seller cancellation recorded against the seller's performance standing |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Seller Fulfilled Standard Shipping | Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays | not applicable | not applicable | Yes |
| Seller Fulfilled Expedited Shipping | Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays | not applicable | not applicable | Yes |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Standard | Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays | not applicable | not applicable | No |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day | Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays | not applicable | not applicable | No |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day | Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays | 12:00 | not applicable | No |
| Large Item Freight Delivery | Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays | not applicable | 4 | Yes |

The business-day calendar governs every business-day count on Marketplace Orders, for every option. The party shown under "Fulfilled by" picks, packs and ships the order and processes its returns.

## Reading the table

- **Which options are fulfilled by Northloop?** Fulfilled by Northloop Standard, Two-Day and Same-Day. The two Seller Fulfilled options and Large Item Freight Delivery are fulfilled by the seller.
- **Which options guarantee the promised delivery date?** Seller Fulfilled Expedited Shipping, Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day, Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day and Large Item Freight Delivery. Seller Fulfilled Standard Shipping and Fulfilled by Northloop Standard do not, and for them the late-delivery request window is not applicable.
- **What does the Same-Day cut-off mean?** A Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day order must be placed by 12:00 local time to be promised for that day. The cut-off has no meaning on any other option.
- **What is the freight appointment window?** On Large Item Freight Delivery the scheduled delivery appointment spans 4 hours. Parcel options have no appointment window.

### Hypothetical illustration of the handling and transit figures

A hypothetical order placed on a Wednesday on Seller Fulfilled Expedited Shipping, with no federal holiday that week, may take 1 business day of handling and 2 business days of transit on the Monday-to-Friday calendar; the same order on Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day takes 0 handling days and 2 transit days. The dates are example inputs only.
